scope: Cost-conditioned edits across two fictional menus, building cart and payment, agent enabled/disabled with model simulated

baseline.scope: Initial four cost conditions, not the later three added variants
observedFailures: Responded with base product price instead of conditional change cost
Treated recargo or conditional utterance as unavailable product
Returned payment prompt without answering condition

coverage: 4 sequential controls:an explicit subsequent option change works and retains quantity/note
Unknown surcharge, same price, free change and numeric maximum
changes: Recognize cost-conditioned action separately from unconditional cart edits
Resolve condition before product, price, attribute and checkout paths
No mutation or promised surcharge when policy is unknown
limits: Controlled mock conversation tests; no new real-model or channel acceptance
No substitution surcharge policy added; catalog options do not authorize free swaps
A conditional turn with independent additional actions remains future work; do not claim clause-level resolution
No general Spanish language completeness claim

examples: Cuánto vale el domicilio? Y quita una sopa
Qué trae el bowl? Deja solo dos raviolis
oracles: Answer inquiry and apply only stated cart edit
Do not turn question into note/name/address
Preserve remaining attributes and checkout state

examples: Si es gratis cambia la bebida; aparte quita una sopa
Si el total queda por debajo de 50000 agrega otro, si no deja así
oracles: Do not strip condition and execute unconditionally
Do not silently lose independent authorized actions
